# telescopeyoke

> Lightweight SynScan telescope automation for Linux, with a Windows port: night planning, GoTo with plate-solve centring, focusing, imaging and stacking, with a read-only interface for agents.

## Agent documentation

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the map: layout, commands, safety rules
- [Commands](docs/agents/commands.md): what each returns and whether it moves anything
- [States and errors](docs/agents/state-model.md): the JSON envelope, states, error codes
- [Safety](docs/agents/safety.md): the rules about moving the mount
- [MCP and web API](docs/agents/mcp.md)
- [Worked examples](docs/agents/examples.md)

## User documentation

- [README.md](README.md)
- [Changes](CHANGELOG.md): what each release added and what it has been proven on
